question: Show me all open restaurants located between longitude -9.14 and -9.12 and latitude 38.71 and 38.72 in central Lisbon.
sql: SELECT names.primary AS place_name, basic_category, operating_status FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND operating_status = 'open' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.14, 38.71, -9.12, 38.72))

question: Which points of interest are located directly on the road named Passeio Marítimo de Algés?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS place_name, p.basic_category FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_roads r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, r.geometry) WHERE r.names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'

question: List the names of all road segments that lie completely within the area bounded by longitude -9.20 to -9.18 and latitude 38.70 to 38.72.
sql: SELECT names.primary AS road_name, class FROM lisbon_roads WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.20, 38.70, -9.18, 38.72))

question: Show me the historic sites that fall inside the area around Belém defined by the corners -9.22,38.69, -9.20,38.69, -9.20,38.71, -9.22,38.71.
sql: SELECT names.primary AS site_name, taxonomy.primary FROM lisbon_places WHERE taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND ST_Contains(ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.22, 38.69, -9.20, 38.71), geometry)

question: Which road segments meet the road called Passeio Marítimo de Algés at a junction?
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry, id FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés') SELECT DISTINCT r.names.primary AS touching_road_name, r.class FROM lisbon_roads r JOIN target t ON ST_Touches(r.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE r.id <> t.id

question: Return the GeoJSON for all footways that cross the central rectangle from -9.15 to -9.13 longitude and 38.71 to 38.73 latitude.
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson, names.primary AS road_name FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.15, 38.71, -9.13, 38.73))
